Lobby

Shot List

    Basic

    Half ball gathering

    To make a break in this game the objective is often to bring the balls together after the shot - a gathering shot. Here its easy to aim half ball but the skill is to play it as gently as possible bringing the red to the same position ready for the next shot.

    Long corner gathering

    Balancing the power to get the red back across the table and not hit the white too hard is key on this one.

    Advanced

    Masse

    This section I would describe as the dark arts - raising the butt of the cue is the last resort in most games but in libre it is frequently used. Here we want to bend the cue ball around the yellow to just glance it and hit the red all at very low pace to keep the balls well nursed in the corner.
